name: Yudai Tanaka
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science listed in official directory; lab opening January 2027 is PI-announced
fitReason: A newly announced CS Assistant Professor with an externally oriented intern-interest form and implemented computational/physical interfaces. Best suited to learned perception for haptics and embodied interaction, with a narrower robotics-AI fit than general manipulation or foundation-model labs.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full CHI 2026 Embodied Devices uses MediaPipe wrist tracking with an RGB camera, feeding a PID controller that modulates real electrical muscle stimulation. A 12-person study uses 600 trials; the experimenter confirms interface invocation to avoid false positives. This is human-body actuation, not a robot arm or learned controller, and was developed at Chicago. Separately, equal-contribution BulkScreen (TEI 2020) implements pretrained CNN saliency-to-depth mapping driving 256 physical pins in Tokyo; it is a work-in-progress demonstration with user evaluation still planned. These attributable prior-host systems support a capped historical physical score, not current UT Austin apparatus access.

unknowns: Official AP title is verified; exact appointment effective date is not independently dated. The PI says the new lab opens January 2027, before the target summer, but setup and hosting readiness remain unknown.
Full 2026 Myo Action is adaptive threshold/signal processing, not an artificial neural-network policy; it is not the learned-physical anchor.

The recent learned component is pretrained MediaPipe perception, while actuation uses classical PID. BulkScreen is older 2020 work-in-progress hardware; do not characterize it as a completed comparative user evaluation.
Form fields establish a route to inquire, not formal external-master eligibility or an eight-week commitment. No inspected no-summer or minimum-duration restriction was stated.

Reused UT Austin policy requires host and ISSS review of academic title, home-degree purpose and immigration category. Separate scholar personal-funding rules cannot automatically be applied to Student Intern.
CS international visitors normally need 3–4 months preparation. Exact 2027 fees, support level, insurance, personal-funding and remote arrangements remain unresolved.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
[Institutional visitor review](../eligibility_notes.md#ut-austin); original policy-observation times are retained.
Any human-participant experiment, stimulation-device access or related data requires a separately approved project, training and institutional review.
